# Hall of Honor Induction Ceremony | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com

# Hall of Honor Induction Ceremony | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com  
Our annual Hall of Honor Dinner, presented by U.S. Steel, will celebrate the induction of this year's Hall of Honor class during a special ceremony at Acrisure Stadium. The evening features drinks, dinner, and the appearance of Steelers Legends. The 2025 Class includes three individuals who were part of Super Bowl seasons for the Steelers - center Maurkice Pouncey, linebacker Joey Porter, and quarterback Ben Roethlisberger.  
_This event is currently**SOLD OUT** \- subscribe to email to be notified of any future ticket opportunities and/or visit this page for the most up-to-date information._  
#### Sunday, December 14  
#### 5:30 - 9:00 PM  
#### Acrisure Stadium  
CONTENT & COVERAGE  
###  Steelers announce 2025 Hall of Honor Class  
The Steelers 2025 Hall of Honor Class includes three who have made a significant impact on the team  
###  WATCH: 2025 Hall of Honor inductees

# Hall of Honor Induction Ceremony | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com

###  Steelers announce 2025 Hall of Honor Class  
The Steelers 2025 Hall of Honor Class includes three who have made a significant impact on the team  
###  WATCH: 2025 Hall of Honor inductees  
The Steelers announce Maurkice Pouncey, Joey Porter and Ben Roethlisberger as the Hall of Honor class of 2025  
###  WATCH: Steelers induct four legends into Hall of Honor  
The Steelers inducted Jason Gildon, Casey Hampton, Dick LeBeau and Willie Parker into the Hall of Honor as part of the Class of 2024 on Saturday night  
###  A night to honor four Steelers legends  
The Steelers inducted four legends into the Hall of Honor as members of the Class of 2024  
###  PHOTOS: 2024 Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony  
The Pittsburgh Steelers celebrated the 2024 Hall of Honor class at Acrisure Stadium during the Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony presented by U.S. Steel  
###  PHOTOS: 2023 Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony

# Hall of Honor Induction Ceremony | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com

###  PHOTOS: 2023 Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony  
The Pittsburgh Steelers celebrated the 2023 Hall of Honor class at Acrisure Stadium during the Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony presented by U.S. Steel  
###  WATCH: Steelers 2022 Hall of Honor Dinner  
The Steelers hosted their 20222 Hall of Honor Dinner Saturday night  
###  A night to celebrate Steelers history  
The Steelers inducted a new Hall of Honor Class on Saturday night  
###  PHOTOS: 2022 Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony  
The Pittsburgh Steelers celebrated the 2022 Hall of Honor class at Acrisure Stadium during the Hall of Honor Dinner Ceremony presented by U.S. Steel  
###  WATCH: Hall of Honor Class of 2022 Announcement  
Stan Savran and Art Rooney II lead a panel including Bill Hillgrove and Bob Labriola to announce the Hall of Honor class of 2022
